_comment: BS-CMP comprehension_questions template — add this array to each day in week{N}.json. marks ∈ {2, 3, 5}. key_points length MUST equal marks. 1-mark MCQs go in practice_questions, NOT here.

comprehension_questions._comment_2mark: 2-Mark: student states 2 distinct key points (speak or type)
comprehension_questions.question: Explain what [concept] is in your own words.
key_points: Key point 1 — one clear, distinct idea
Key point 2 — second clear, distinct idea
comprehension_questions.model_answer: Full ideal answer in 1-2 sentences covering both key points. Used by the LLM as a gold standard for calibration.
comprehension_questions.explanation: Marking guide: a full 2-mark answer covers both the [aspect A] AND [aspect B].

comprehension_questions._comment_3mark: 3-Mark: student states 3 distinct key points (speak or type)
comprehension_questions.question: Describe three important [features / steps / reasons] related to [concept].
comprehension_questions.model_answer: Full ideal answer covering all 3 key points in 2-3 sentences.
comprehension_questions.explanation: Marking guide: a full 3-mark answer must identify all three: [A], [B], and [C].

comprehension_questions._comment_5mark: 5-Mark: extended articulation with 5 distinct key points
comprehension_questions.question: Elaborate on [topic]. Give valid reasons or examples.
comprehension_questions.model_answer: Full ideal answer — 4-5 sentences covering all 5 key points with supporting examples.
comprehension_questions.explanation: Marking guide: a 5-mark answer requires 5 distinct, well-reasoned points covering different aspects.

_rules.marks_values: Only 2, 3, or 5. Never 1 (MCQs go in practice_questions).
_rules.key_points_count: MUST equal marks. 2 marks → 2 key_points, 3 marks → 3 key_points, 5 marks → 5 key_points.
_rules.model_answer: Write the ideal answer the LLM uses to calibrate evaluation. Be specific and complete.
_rules.media_src: Relative path under MEDIA_ROOT (media/ directory). Frontend constructs full URL as {DJANGO_BASE_URL}/media/{src}.
_rules.media_optional: Set media to [] if no media is needed.
_rules.key_points_withheld: key_points are NOT sent to the frontend before submission. Only revealed in the evaluation response.
